sources.title: Visual question answering · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Visual question answering Visual Question Answering (VQA) is the task of answering open-ended questions based on an image. The input to models supporting this task is typically a combination of an image and a question, and the output is an answer expressed in natural language.
